weighting: Each valid daily closing PE has equal weight; compute median of1212 daily values, not average of annual medians.
filter: 2021-11-03<=TRADE_DATE<=2026-11-03; positive non-null PE_TTM; deduplicate trading date.
crosscheck: Eastmoney latest closing price29.86 matches Tencent; PE22.37478653 rounds to quoted22.37. Nov3 actual daily record is included in all historical statistics.
percentile_definition: Share of1212 daily PE observations less than or equal to latest PE; valuation rank, not probability of return.
notes: 2021 and2026 calendar-year rows cover only dates within this window.
Use supplied PE_TTM, not forecast/static PE or adjusted prices divided by present EPS.
Historical data follow provider financial revision and corporate-action conventions; no point-in-time backtest.
